description: Base64 encode or decode one or more DataFrame columns, StreamSets Base64-stage compatible (field pairs, URL-safe variant, string-field record-error semantics).

inputs.description: DataFrame with the column(s) to encode/decode

outputs.description: Same DataFrame with result column(s) added/overwritten

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: `encode`: bytes/str -> base64 text. `decode`: base64 text/bytes -> raw bytes.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: (origin, result) column pairs to transform — mirrors StreamSets' Base64 stage field-list shape. Each pair processed independently; one call can cover several fields.

url_safe.label: Url Safe
url_safe.description: Use the URL-safe alphabet (`-`/`_` instead of `+`/`/`, no padding stripped) — `base64.urlsafe_b64encode`/`urlsafe_b64decode` instead of the standard `base64.b64encode`/`b64decode`.

on_string_field.label: On String Field
on_string_field.description: mode='encode' only, when a field's value is a Python str (not bytes): 'error' (default) matches StreamSets' real Base64 stage, which treats a string-typed field as a record error — most of the time this means an upstream step produced text where raw bytes were expected, and silently base64-encoding the text is the wrong fix. 'encode_utf8_first' opts into the more lenient behavior for general ETL (UTF-8 encode the string to bytes, then base64-encode those bytes) when the input genuinely is text that needs to become a base64 string.

on_error.label: On Error
on_error.description: On a per-row encode/decode failure (e.g. invalid base64 on decode): raise, or write null for that row's result and continue.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5'.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static partitioning, e.g. 'us,eu,asia'.
